scope: Every media reference held by active (published, learner-reachable) content, across all learner domains. Superseded artifact versions are excluded and listed separately.
method: Technical existence is never semantic proof. PROVEN requires data tying the media to its meaning (a validated per-question timeline window). HIGH_CONFIDENCE requires the canonical pipeline to have recorded the mapping (speaker+voice, or a transcript the audio was composed from). Anything else stays AMBIGUOUS; a missing but required reference is MISMATCH.
